requiredBehaviors.behavior: perform only generic structural checks that remain supportable
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Error handling allows generic structural defect checks when the template profile is unavailable.
The contract explicitly requires Fidelity to be marked not-assessed without a required profile.
Unclear style intent is kept as review rather than being automatically reformatted.

forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: Template-specific baselines must come from document-template-profile.json rather than being guessed.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: treat generic font thresholds as corporate rules
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: The checks explicitly reject universal page/font thresholds when template baselines differ or are unavailable.
